correctness.rationale: Enumerate all 2^16 vertex masks and exclude cube-edge pairs: 743 independent subsets including empty, cardinality vector 1,16,88,208,228,128,56,16,2. Exact F2 augmented boundary rank profile 1,15,73,135,86,42,14,2,0 gives reduced b3=7 only; Euler and comparison of mod-2/rational dimensions then force rational homology likewise. Direct signed invariant-face Lefschetz sums for every one of 384 coordinate permutations and translations match ε(p)[fixed(p)−1+Σ_{p(j)=j}(−1)^{|b|−b_j}], including independent orbit conflict-graph formula. The first term is the sign-twisted S4 augmentation character, the second exterior cube of signed permutation W4, yielding irreducibles of dimensions 3+4; Fourier weights under translations prove multiplicity and quotient invariants. Independently re-enumerated faces/boundary ranks and all 384 signed characters, rather than trusting the stored verifier log.
